generator-15.title: Rounded Corner Image (Transparent PNG)
generator-15.intro: Upload 1–12 PNG/JPEG/WebP images, apply a corner radius by percentage of the short side or fixed pixels, and export transparent-corner PNGs with batch download. All processing stays in your browser.

en.title: Rounded Corner Image (Transparent PNG)
en.intro: Upload 1–12 PNG/JPEG/WebP images, apply a corner radius by percentage of the short side or fixed pixels, and export transparent-corner PNGs with batch download. All processing stays in your browser.

image-converter.title: Image Format Converter
image-converter.intro: Convert PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images to JPEG/PNG/WebP, output several formats at once, and adjust quality, longest side or JPEG background locally; alpha is preserved where supported.

en.title: Image Format Converter
en.intro: Convert PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF images to JPEG/PNG/WebP, output several formats at once, and adjust quality, longest side or JPEG background locally; alpha is preserved where supported.

gif-split.title: Gif Split
gif-split.intro: 上传 GIF 动画，自动提取每一帧并显示，可单独下载 PNG 或批量打包 ZIP；支持帧范围与帧号跳转，纯前端处理文件不上传。

en.title: Gif Split
en.intro: Extract every frame from a GIF as PNG, download one or all frames as a ZIP with frame metadata, and inspect original delays—all locally in your browser with no upload.

nine-grid-cutter.title: Nine-Grid Cutter
nine-grid-cutter.intro: Split into custom 1–6 rows × 1–6 columns with 3×3, 2×2, 3×2 and 2×3 presets; adjust crop position, fit with padding or slice at the original aspect; export equal-size or pixel-exact PNG tiles.

wechat-cover-maker.title: WeChat Cover Generator
wechat-cover-maker.intro: Lay out and export at the selected size: title and subtitle auto-fit, signature toggle/custom text, no text cropping.

image-compress.title: Image Compressor
image-compress.intro: Compress JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and BMP images locally in the browser; GIF/BMP are exported as a static frame and files never leave your device.

en.title: Image Compressor
en.intro: Compress JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and BMP images locally in the browser; GIF/BMP are exported as a static frame and files never leave your device.

image-watermark.title: Image Watermark
image-watermark.intro: Add text or image watermarks with 9-grid/custom placement, single or tiled coverage, separate stroke color, rotation and opacity, then export PNG/JPEG/WebP locally; JPEG is flattened onto white and images never leave your device.

en.title: Image Watermark
en.intro: Add text or image watermarks with 9-grid/custom placement, single or tiled coverage, separate stroke color, rotation and opacity, then export PNG/JPEG/WebP locally; JPEG is flattened onto white and images never leave your device.

image-filter.title: Image Filter Studio
image-filter.intro: Filter one local image with 20 presets and brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, blur, grayscale, sepia and invert sliders; hold to compare with the original and export a PNG locally without uploading.

en.title: Image Filter Studio
en.intro: Filter one local image with 20 presets and brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, blur, grayscale, sepia and invert sliders; hold to compare with the original and export a PNG locally without uploading.

image-crop.title: Image Crop
image-crop.intro: Crop images locally: drag a box or handles, lock an aspect ratio, nudge with the keyboard, rotate in 90° steps, or type exact X/Y/W/H. Export PNG/JPEG without uploading.

en.title: Image Crop
en.intro: Crop images locally: drag a box or handles, lock an aspect ratio, nudge with the keyboard, rotate in 90° steps, or type exact X/Y/W/H. Export PNG/JPEG without uploading.

image-mosaic.title: Image Mosaic
image-mosaic.intro: Pixelate or solid-mask one image; choose whole-image or region mode, add exact selections by source coordinates, keep multiple regions, preview live, and export PNG/JPG locally. Pixelation cannot guarantee that text or faces are unrecognizable; use the opaque solid mask for high-risk details and inspect the exported file.

en.title: Image Mosaic
en.intro: Pixelate or solid-mask one image; choose whole-image or region mode, add exact selections by source coordinates, keep multiple regions, preview live, and export PNG/JPG locally. Pixelation cannot guarantee that text or faces are unrecognizable; use the opaque solid mask for high-risk details and inspect the exported file.

id-photo-crop.title: ID Photo Cropper
id-photo-crop.intro: Crop a photo to one-inch/two-inch/passport or custom pixel sizes, with margin fill, PNG/JPEG export, DPI and size hints. Background replacement and compliance are not automatic; verify against the application rules.
